description: A daemon with no git reader wired refuses `workspace.git.status` by name rather than answering. Note what is NOT an error: `not-a-repo` and `unavailable` are STATES inside a successful answer — the daemon asked git and git answered. This refusal is the case where the daemon cannot ask at all, and guessing is the one answer it may not give (D7/P31).

data.what: no git reader is wired into this daemon
data.means: the answer would have been a guess — `ok`, `not-a-repo` and `unavailable` each claim to KNOW something, and a daemon that cannot exec git knows nothing
data.todo: run the daemon with its workspace tools (`internal/workspace` is the bounded git reader the daemon wires)
